Rabi irrigated wheat; late March heatwaves (>35 °C) shrivel grain and Phalaris minor resistance builds in rice-wheat.
Kharif maize requires ~60% less irrigation water than paddy rice and leaves easily incorporated residue.
65-day summer/kharif pulse (PAU SML-668/832); fixes ~30 kg N/ha and eliminates synthetic starter N for following wheat.
Low-water rabi pulse (Desi gram); breaks grassy weed resistance in continuous wheat fields.
Rabi lentil suited to lighter alluvial loams; sensitive to excess flood irrigation.
Rabi Gobhi Sarson / Indian Mustard; high oil return with half the irrigation requirement of rabi wheat.
Very low water need; good alternative to paddy in kharif.
